meta.title: A Platform Modernization Story
meta.voiceDirection: Wes Anderson register: a chronicler reading from a ledger. Deadpan, unhurried, faintly amused, never excited. Numbers read evenly, like an inventory.
meta.modelNote: break tags are reliable on multilingual_v2. Newer models may ignore them - use textV3 (breaks converted to em-dashes and ellipses) if you switch to v3.

scenes.text: A platform modernization. <break time="400ms"/> In four acts.
scenes.textV3: A platform modernization. — In four acts.

scenes.text: Faster. Lighter. Built to scale. <break time="600ms"/> Those were the instructions. <break time="400ms"/> What follows is what happened.
scenes.textV3: Faster. Lighter. Built to scale. … Those were the instructions. — What follows is what happened.

scenes.text: Act One. The Weight of Growth. <break time="600ms"/> Every success arrived carrying luggage.
scenes.textV3: Act One. The Weight of Growth. … Every success arrived carrying luggage.

scenes.text: Thirteen megabytes, on every visit. <break time="400ms"/> Six seconds before anything appeared. <break time="400ms"/> And fifteen filter systems — each of them slightly different.
scenes.textV3: Thirteen megabytes, on every visit. — Six seconds before anything appeared. — And fifteen filter systems — each of them slightly different.

scenes.text: Act Two. The Rebuild. <break time="600ms"/> They began, as one does, by deleting things.
scenes.textV3: Act Two. The Rebuild. … They began, as one does, by deleting things.

scenes.text: Two hundred twenty-nine commits. One thousand seven hundred sixty-eight files. <break time="500ms"/> They deleted more than they wrote. <break time="300ms"/> On purpose.
scenes.textV3: Two hundred twenty-nine commits. One thousand seven hundred sixty-eight files. — They deleted more than they wrote. — On purpose.

scenes.text: The application had been shipped as one enormous parcel. <break time="500ms"/> It was opened, sorted, and repacked. <break time="300ms"/> Two hundred forty-nine smaller ones.
scenes.textV3: The application had been shipped as one enormous parcel. — It was opened, sorted, and repacked. — Two hundred forty-nine smaller ones.

scenes.text: This is where the weight had been living. <break time="600ms"/> Four bundles, comfortable, undisturbed, <break time="300ms"/> and downloaded by every single visitor.
scenes.textV3: This is where the weight had been living. … Four bundles, comfortable, undisturbed, — and downloaded by every single visitor.

scenes.text: Previously, the dashboard asked for everything. <break time="500ms"/> Now it asks for what the dashboard needs. <break time="400ms"/> A modest idea, arrived at late.
scenes.textV3: Previously, the dashboard asked for everything. — Now it asks for what the dashboard needs. — A modest idea, arrived at late.

scenes.text: Without preload, the browser discovers its files one after another. <break time="500ms"/> With it, it collects the important ones at once. <break time="300ms"/> The page begins sooner.
scenes.textV3: Without preload, the browser discovers its files one after another. — With it, it collects the important ones at once. — The page begins sooner.

scenes.text: Consider the sidebar. <break time="500ms"/> The pointer merely rests on Inbox — it does not click — <break time="400ms"/> and the page's bundles begin arriving quietly in the background. <break time="500ms"/> Assets only. <break time="300ms"/> Zero requests to the server. <break time="400ms"/> Nobody has decided anything yet.
scenes.textV3: Consider the sidebar. — The pointer merely rests on Inbox — it does not click — and the page's bundles begin arriving quietly in the background. — Assets only. — Zero requests to the server. — Nobody has decided anything yet.

scenes.text: One function. <break time="400ms"/> Three hundred fifty-seven kilobytes. <break time="500ms"/> Delivered faithfully, on every page load, <break time="300ms"/> to people who never once used it.
scenes.textV3: One function. — Three hundred fifty-seven kilobytes. — Delivered faithfully, on every page load, — to people who never once used it.

scenes.text: The remedy was a single line. <break time="600ms"/> Three hundred fifty-seven kilobytes became zero. <break time="400ms"/> These are the most satisfying repairs, and the least visible.
scenes.textV3: The remedy was a single line. … Three hundred fifty-seven kilobytes became zero. — These are the most satisfying repairs, and the least visible.

scenes.text: Time to paint: halved. <break time="500ms"/> The screen now arrives before the user has finished deciding to wait for it.
scenes.textV3: Time to paint: halved. — The screen now arrives before the user has finished deciding to wait for it.

scenes.text: For years the build required twelve gigabytes of heap <break time="300ms"/> and a ten-gigabyte swap file, <break time="400ms"/> to keep it from collapsing. <break time="600ms"/> Rolldown bundles in Rust — off the Node heap entirely. <break time="500ms"/> So the swap file was deleted. The heap fell to four. <break time="500ms"/> The scaffolding came down, <break time="300ms"/> because the building no longer falls down.
scenes.textV3: For years the build required twelve gigabytes of heap — and a ten-gigabyte swap file, — to keep it from collapsing. … Rolldown bundles in Rust — off the Node heap entirely. — So the swap file was deleted. The heap fell to four. — The scaffolding came down, — because the building no longer falls down.

scenes.text: Certain lessons were written down, <break time="400ms"/> so that they would not have to be learned a second time.
scenes.textV3: Certain lessons were written down, — so that they would not have to be learned a second time.

scenes.text: The styles had been living inside the JavaScript, <break time="400ms"/> recomputed in the browser on every render. <break time="600ms"/> They were moved into ordinary files. <break time="400ms"/> They are now computed once — by the build.
scenes.textV3: The styles had been living inside the JavaScript, — recomputed in the browser on every render. … They were moved into ordinary files. — They are now computed once — by the build.

scenes.text: Cascade layers decide who wins. <break time="500ms"/> Ours are ordered; the last one always does. <break time="600ms"/> Then version six arrived with unlayered styles — <break time="400ms"/> outside every layer, and therefore above them all. <break time="300ms"/> This was handled.
scenes.textV3: Cascade layers decide who wins. — Ours are ordered; the last one always does. … Then version six arrived with unlayered styles — outside every layer, and therefore above them all. — This was handled.

scenes.text: There had been fifteen filter systems. <break time="500ms"/> One fix required fifteen fixes. <break time="600ms"/> They became a single configuration-driven module — <break time="400ms"/> roughly sixty-five percent of the filter layer, simply gone.
scenes.textV3: There had been fifteen filter systems. — One fix required fifteen fixes. … They became a single configuration-driven module — roughly sixty-five percent of the filter layer, simply gone.

scenes.text: One filter now. <break time="400ms"/> The same pills, the same saved views, <break time="300ms"/> across fifteen pages that had never once agreed.
scenes.textV3: One filter now. — The same pills, the same saved views, — across fifteen pages that had never once agreed.

scenes.text: It can be operated entirely by keyboard. <break time="600ms"/> The people who work here all day <break time="300ms"/> tend to notice this first.
scenes.textV3: It can be operated entirely by keyboard. … The people who work here all day — tend to notice this first.

scenes.text: Architecture that compounds. <break time="500ms"/> Each thing built on it is cheaper than the thing before it.
scenes.textV3: Architecture that compounds. — Each thing built on it is cheaper than the thing before it.

scenes.text: Formerly, every tile fetched at once, whether or not you looked at it. <break time="600ms"/> Now a tile fetches when it enters view. <break time="300ms"/> Not before.
scenes.textV3: Formerly, every tile fetched at once, whether or not you looked at it. … Now a tile fetches when it enters view. — Not before.

scenes.text: The list renders only what is on screen. <break time="500ms"/> A thousand rows, or ten. <break time="400ms"/> The browser cannot tell the difference.
scenes.textV3: The list renders only what is on screen. — A thousand rows, or ten. — The browser cannot tell the difference.

scenes.text: Your place is kept in the address bar. <break time="500ms"/> The filters, the page, the customer — all of it. <break time="600ms"/> You may now send a colleague a link <break time="400ms"/> and be entirely confident about what they will see.
scenes.textV3: Your place is kept in the address bar. — The filters, the page, the customer — all of it. … You may now send a colleague a link — and be entirely confident about what they will see.

scenes.text: React eighteen. Vite eight. React Query. <break time="500ms"/> The foundation was replaced while the building remained open.
scenes.textV3: React eighteen. Vite eight. React Query. — The foundation was replaced while the building remained open.

scenes.text: Four leaks were found in the startup path. <break time="500ms"/> Objects created on every render, and never once closed. <break time="300ms"/> They are closed now.
scenes.textV3: Four leaks were found in the startup path. — Objects created on every render, and never once closed. — They are closed now.

scenes.text: Act Three. The Payoff. <break time="600ms"/> What all of it actually bought.
scenes.textV3: Act Three. The Payoff. … What all of it actually bought.

scenes.text: The dashboard loads in seven hundred fifty-five milliseconds. <break time="400ms"/> Two and a half megabytes. <break time="400ms"/> Fourteen startup calls, where there had been forty-three.
scenes.textV3: The dashboard loads in seven hundred fifty-five milliseconds. — Two and a half megabytes. — Fourteen startup calls, where there had been forty-three.

scenes.text: Every line moves in the same direction. <break time="600ms"/> This is rarer than it sounds, <break time="300ms"/> and was not guaranteed.
scenes.textV3: Every line moves in the same direction. … This is rarer than it sounds, — and was not guaranteed.

scenes.text: Two thirds less code was written. <break time="400ms"/> Compression did the remaining third. <break time="600ms"/> We cite the bytes that crossed the network — <break time="300ms"/> those are the ones the user waits for.
scenes.textV3: Two thirds less code was written. — Compression did the remaining third. … We cite the bytes that crossed the network — those are the ones the user waits for.

scenes.text: The build once took one minute and forty-four seconds. <break time="600ms"/> It now takes fifteen. <break time="500ms"/> Ninety seconds returned, on every push, <break time="300ms"/> to every engineer, forever.
scenes.textV3: The build once took one minute and forty-four seconds. … It now takes fifteen. — Ninety seconds returned, on every push, — to every engineer, forever.

scenes.text: Some honesty, briefly. <break time="500ms"/> Different deployments. Different datasets. Cold loads. <break time="400ms"/> Read the direction — <break time="300ms"/> and not the decimals.
scenes.textV3: Some honesty, briefly. — Different deployments. Different datasets. Cold loads. — Read the direction — and not the decimals.

scenes.text: One filter system. <break time="400ms"/> Not fifteen. <break time="600ms"/> If you remember a single line, we would prefer it were that one.
scenes.textV3: One filter system. — Not fifteen. … If you remember a single line, we would prefer it were that one.

scenes.text: It loads two and a half times faster. <break time="400ms"/> The feeds no longer freeze. <break time="400ms"/> Customers did not need to be told any of this.
scenes.textV3: It loads two and a half times faster. — The feeds no longer freeze. — Customers did not need to be told any of this.

scenes.text: One toolkit. Less code to own. <break time="500ms"/> The team now spends its time on things that did not exist last year.
scenes.textV3: One toolkit. Less code to own. — The team now spends its time on things that did not exist last year.

scenes.text: Act Four. The Agents. <break time="600ms"/> A fast build introduced a new kind of mistake.
scenes.textV3: Act Four. The Agents. … A fast build introduced a new kind of mistake.

scenes.text: The component library now ships its own expertise. <break time="500ms"/> Alfred keeps the house. He does not write code. <break time="400ms"/> He determines who should. <break time="600ms"/> A quick question, you look up yourself. <break time="400ms"/> A real job is sent away — and reports back.
scenes.textV3: The component library now ships its own expertise. — Alfred keeps the house. He does not write code. — He determines who should. … A quick question, you look up yourself. — A real job is sent away — and reports back.

scenes.text: Neo reads every pull request before anyone else does. <break time="600ms"/> On this one, it found a command-injection hole — <break time="400ms"/> in the workflow written to harden the pipeline. <break time="600ms"/> One dollar and seventy-six cents. <break time="400ms"/> Seven and a half minutes. <break time="300ms"/> No human had opened the file.
scenes.textV3: Neo reads every pull request before anyone else does. … On this one, it found a command-injection hole — in the workflow written to harden the pipeline. … One dollar and seventy-six cents. — Seven and a half minutes. — No human had opened the file.

scenes.text: The platform, re-engineered. <break time="700ms"/> Faster, lighter, and considerably harder to break. <break time="500ms"/> Thank you for your attention.
scenes.textV3: The platform, re-engineered. … Faster, lighter, and considerably harder to break. — Thank you for your attention.
